author: Fextralife
description:
Fable Hands-On Gameplay Impressions
In this video, I want to talk about my hands-on impressions. Having played Fable, I got the opportunity to play the exact same stretch of game that you are going to see in this gameplay segment here. This is a predominantly combat-focused segment where you're just fighting through groups of enemies, kind of doing what looks to be a side quest of sorts, or possibly part of the main quest of this area.
